title: Unique strict assembly of the fixed finite scalar tensor components
statement: For arbitrary integral cochain complexes P,Q, the explicit finite tensor maps of [lem-coef-tensor-reduction-finite-components], transported by [lem-coef-tensor-reduction-evaluation-identification], determine a unique strict chain map from ordinary coherent reduction of their total tensor to the total coherent tensor of their ordinary reductions. The chosen map has exactly those canonical finite components. No derived comparison or good-complex hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6 and 0941; steps 1 and 2 of lem-coef-tensor-reduction-ordinary-model

proof.text: The finite quotient compatibility theorem supplies the horizontal equation. Apply sequenceComplexHom_existsUnique, using the actual pro-etale site smallness witness, to assemble the finite cochain maps uniquely. This fixes tensorReductionStrictMap up to equality, so the use of unique choice selects fully determined data.

Rewrite the finite-component equation by tensorReductionSystemFiniteComponent_eq. Naturality of the shared complex evaluation isomorphism and cancellation of its hom transport the generic evaluation equation to canonical evaluation. This proves the canonical component equation.
